# ZynAddSubFX

ZynAddSubFX is a powerful synthesizer with a wide range of sounds. It has its own GUI with the options for simple or advanced controls, as well as its own effects system. ZynAddSubFX is the most powerful embedded synthesizer in LMMS.

![ZynAddSubFX](https://2675558978-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LRtsae7H2l0Wn3A4biK-1972196547%2Fuploads%2FirkaHe78sag49ffrPnlG%2FScreenshot%202025-01-25%20231555.png?alt=media\&token=9228b0b3-ddba-4d20-aafc-36afb06c65be)

This article will not cover ZynAddSubFX, not even remotely. It would without any kind of "story-telling" be easy to write a 500 page book, and still come up short...! If you want to learn the most important features, you should watch the [Video Tutorials](/user-manual/resources/videos.md#zynaddsubfx) video tutorials, there you can get specific hands-on visualizations of the most important things. Otherwise, you can read the official ZynAddSubFX documentation [here](https://zynaddsubfx.sourceforge.io/Doc/) on SourceForge.

Here, we will only look at the special LMMS controllers and that is an absolute insignificant scratch of the surface, of this amazing synthesizer!
